description.zh: 泰姬陵是莫卧儿皇帝沙贾汗为悼念爱妻慕塔芝·玛哈尔而建的白色大理石陵墓，1632年始建，被誉为世界七大奇迹之一和「永恒的爱情象征」。
description.en: The Taj Mahal is a white marble mausoleum built by Mughal emperor Shah Jahan for his beloved wife Mumtaz Mahal from 1632. One of the Seven Wonders of the World and an eternal symbol of love.

zh: 世界遗产
七大奇迹
莫卧儿建筑

location.zh: 北方邦阿格拉市

zh: 莫卧儿帝国爱情宫殿，世界新七大奇迹之一
白色大理石在不同光线下呈现不同色彩
波斯、印度、伊斯兰建筑艺术的完美融合
en: Mughal love monument and one of the New Seven Wonders
White marble shifts colour from gold at dawn to pearlescent at dusk
Perfect synthesis of Persian, Indian and Islamic architecture

admission.zh: 外国游客约1,100卢比（约92元）

tips.zh: 日出时分光线最美人最少，建议购买提前预约票。周五全天关闭，注意错开。
tips.en: Sunrise is the most beautiful and least crowded time. Book tickets online in advance. Closed all day Friday.

description.zh: 瓦拉纳西是印度最神圣的城市，也是世界上最古老的持续有人居住的城市之一。每天清晨，成千上万的印度教信徒在恒河河坛（Ghat）边沐浴祈祷，场景庄严神圣。
description.en: Varanasi is India's holiest city and one of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities. Each dawn, thousands of Hindu pilgrims bathe and pray on the river ghats in scenes of profound spiritual intensity.

zh: 宗教圣地
恒河
印度教

location.zh: 北方邦瓦拉纳西市

zh: 印度最古老的城市之一，恒河边最神圣的朝圣地
日出时恒河沐浴仪式与晨祷
夜晚的恒河火供仪式（Ganga Aarti）震撼人心
en: One of the world's oldest cities; holiest Hindu pilgrimage site
Dawn bathing rituals and prayers on the Ganges ghats
Nightly Ganga Aarti fire ceremony on the riverbank

admission.zh: 大多数区域免费

tips.zh: 乘坐晨间船只游览各大ghats是必选项目；尊重当地宗教习俗，着装保守，拍照前征得同意。
tips.en: An early-morning boat ride along the ghats is essential. Dress modestly and always ask permission before photographing cremation sites or rituals.

description.zh: 喀拉拉邦的水乡是由900余公里的河流、湖泊和运河构成的网络。乘坐传统的茅草船屋（Kettuvallam）在棕榈树成荫的水道中漂流，体验南印度独特的水上生活方式。
description.en: Kerala's backwaters are a network of 900+ km of rivers, lakes and canals. Drifting through palm-shaded waterways in a traditional thatched houseboat (Kettuvallam) is an iconic South Indian experience.

zh: 水乡
船屋
热带风光

location.zh: 喀拉拉邦，印度西南部

zh: 超过900公里的内陆水网、湖泊与运河
传统双层柚木游船（Kettuvallam）住宿体验
椰林掩映的宁静水道，与世隔绝
en: Over 900 km of inland waterways, lakes and canals
Overnight stays on traditional teak houseboats (kettuvallam)

admission.zh: 船屋通常按天计费，约3,000—8,000卢比/天/船

tips.zh: 阿莱皮（Alleppey）是预订船屋最方便的出发点，10—3月气候最宜人，避开季风季节。
tips.en: Alleppey (Alappuzha) is the best base for booking houseboats. October–March is the most pleasant season; avoid the monsoon.

description.zh: 斋浦尔是拉贾斯坦邦首府，因城中众多建筑采用玫瑰粉色砂岩建造而得名「粉红之城」。2019年列入UNESCO世界遗产，保存完好的棋盘格街道规划与宏伟宫殿建筑完整体现了印度古代城市规划理念。
description.en: Jaipur is Rajasthan's capital — the 'Pink City' named for its rose-coloured sandstone buildings. UNESCO-listed in 2019, its well-preserved grid street plan and grand palaces embody ancient Indian city-planning principles.

zh: 世界遗产
历史古城
拉贾斯坦

location.zh: 拉贾斯坦邦斋浦尔市

zh: 粉红城市，整座旧城建筑统一刷成陶土粉色
风之宫殿（Hawa Mahal）953个蜂窝状格窗
琥珀堡（Amber Fort）雄踞山顶，壮观无比
en: The 'Pink City' — entire old town uniformly painted terracotta pink
Amber Fort dramatically crowning the hilltop

admission.zh: 琥珀堡约500卢比，风之宫殿约200卢比

tips.zh: 斋普尔是「黄金三角」（德里—阿格拉—斋普尔）的一角，三城联游最为经济高效。
tips.en: Jaipur forms one point of the 'Golden Triangle' with Delhi and Agra — the three cities together make a highly efficient itinerary.

description.zh: 果阿拥有印度最美丽的海滩，北果阿的派纳吉和卡兰古特海滩热闹繁华，南果阿的帕洛莱姆则宁静祥和。葡萄牙殖民时期留下的巴洛克教堂与热带海滩融为一体。
description.en: Goa has India's finest beaches. North Goa's Panaji and Calangute buzz with energy; South Goa's Palolem is serenely beautiful. Portuguese Baroque churches blend with tropical coastline.

zh: 海滩
葡式建筑
热带风情

location.zh: 果阿邦，印度西海岸

zh: 北果阿的葡式殖民建筑与夜市文化
南果阿帕洛莱姆等宁静原始海湾
果阿独特的印葡融合美食
en: North Goa's Portuguese colonial architecture and night markets
Quieter, pristine beaches in South Goa like Palolem

admission.zh: 海滩免费

tips.zh: 11月至2月是旺季，气候最宜人；6—9月季风大雨，大多数度假村关闭。
tips.en: November–February is the ideal season; June–September brings heavy monsoon rains and most resorts close.

description.zh: 阿格拉堡是莫卧儿帝国的主要宫堡，16世纪由阿克巴大帝始建，红色砂岩城墙绵延约2.5公里。沙贾汗皇帝在此被其子奥朗则布软禁晚年，从此可遥望他亲手建造的泰姬陵。1983年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Agra Fort was the principal Mughal palace-fortress, begun by Emperor Akbar in the 16th century. Its red sandstone walls stretch 2.5 km. Shah Jahan spent his final years here under house arrest, gazing at the Taj Mahal he had built. UNESCO-listed in 1983.

zh: 世界遗产
莫卧儿建筑
阿格拉

location.zh: 北方邦阿格拉市

zh: 红色砂岩城墙绵延2.5公里，气势磅礴
贾汗吉尔宫、穆萨曼宝塔等精美宫殿建筑
从穆萨曼宝塔可遥望泰姬陵，是拍摄泰姬陵的绝佳机位
en: 2.5 km of dramatic red sandstone ramparts
Elegant Mughal palaces including Jahangir's Palace and Musamman Burj tower
Musamman Burj offers a classic view of the Taj Mahal in the distance

admission.zh: 外国游客650卢比

tips.zh: 通常与泰姬陵安排在同一天游览，两处相距仅2公里。购买「日落套票」可覆盖阿格拉多处景点。
tips.en: Usually visited the same day as the Taj Mahal, just 2 km away. A combined 'Sunset Ticket' covers multiple Agra monuments.

description.zh: 阿旃陀石窟是公元前2世纪至公元6世纪开凿的30座岩凿佛教石窟，以保存极为完好的佛教壁画和雕塑著称，被誉为古代世界最伟大的艺术宝库之一。1983年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Ajanta Caves are 30 rock-cut Buddhist monuments created from the 2nd century BCE to the 6th century CE. Renowned for their extraordinarily well-preserved paintings and sculptures, they are considered one of the greatest artistic treasures of the ancient world. UNESCO-listed in 1983.

zh: 世界遗产
佛教
石窟艺术

location.zh: 马哈拉施特拉邦奥兰加巴德区

zh: 30座岩凿石窟，壁画描绘佛陀本生故事，色彩历千年依然鲜艳
第1、2号窟：保存最精美的摩羯陀时期壁画
马蹄形峡谷中的石窟群景观，本身即是一处壮观的自然奇观
en: 30 rock-cut caves with murals depicting Jataka tales, still vivid after 1,500 years
Caves 1 and 2: the finest surviving Vakataka-period painting cycles
The horseshoe-shaped gorge setting is itself a dramatic natural spectacle

admission.zh: 外国游客600卢比

tips.zh: 通常与埃洛拉石窟安排在同一行程，两地相距约100公里。周一休息。光线较暗，建议携带手电筒。
tips.en: Usually combined with Ellora Caves (~100 km apart) in a two-day itinerary. Closed Monday. Bring a torch for dimly lit caves.

description.zh: 埃洛拉石窟是34座从公元5世纪至11世纪开凿的佛教、印度教和耆那教石窟的集合，其中凯拉萨神庙是世界上最大的单体岩凿建筑，整座神庙从一块整岩中雕凿而成。1983年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Ellora is a group of 34 rock-cut Buddhist, Hindu and Jain monuments carved between the 5th and 11th centuries CE. The Kailasa Temple is the world's largest monolithic rock-cut structure, carved entirely from a single volcanic basalt cliff. UNESCO-listed in 1983.

zh: 世界遗产
岩凿建筑
多元宗教

location.zh: 马哈拉施特拉邦奥兰加巴德区

zh: 凯拉萨神庙（第16窟）：世界最大单体岩凿建筑，用时逾100年
佛教、印度教、耆那教三种宗教石窟和平共存
从峡谷顶端俯瞰凯拉萨神庙的壮观俯视景观
en: Kailasa Temple (Cave 16): world's largest monolithic rock-cut structure, taking over 100 years to carve
Buddhist, Hindu and Jain caves coexisting in peaceful proximity
The clifftop view overlooking Kailasa Temple is breathtaking

admission.zh: 外国游客600卢比

tips.zh: 距奥兰加巴德约30公里，有公交和出租车直达。周二休息。建议下午游览，避开上午旅游团高峰。
tips.en: About 30 km from Aurangabad by bus or taxi. Closed Tuesday. Visit in the afternoon to avoid morning group tours.

description.zh: 象岛石窟位于孟买港湾中的象岛上，以7座主要石窟中规模宏大的印度教湿婆神像群著称，其中三面湿婆（Trimurti）高约6米，是印度最著名的雕塑之一。1987年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: The Elephanta Caves on Gharapuri island in Mumbai Harbour feature monumental Hindu Shaiva rock sculptures in seven main caves. The 6-metre Trimurti (three-headed Shiva) is one of India's most celebrated sculptures. UNESCO-listed in 1987.

zh: 世界遗产
印度教
石窟艺术

location.zh: 马哈拉施特拉邦孟买港象岛

zh: 三面湿婆（Trimurti）：6米高的三头湿婆雕像，古典印度雕塑代表作
七座主石窟及数座小窟，约5—8世纪雕刻
从孟买游轮码头乘船约1小时，船程本身也是游览孟买港的好机会
en: Trimurti: 6-metre three-headed Shiva, a masterpiece of classical Indian sculpture
Seven main caves and smaller shrines, carved c. 5th–8th century CE
The 1-hour ferry from Mumbai's Gateway of India is itself a scenic harbour cruise

admission.zh: 外国游客600卢比（不含渡轮票）

tips.zh: 从印度门（Gateway of India）乘公共渡轮约1小时，票价约200卢比。周一休息。岛上有小吃摊，但建议在孟买用餐。
tips.en: Take the public ferry from Gateway of India (~₹200, 1 hour). Closed Monday. There are snack stalls on the island but eat in Mumbai for better options.

description.zh: 科纳克太阳神庙建于13世纪，整座建筑设计成太阳神苏利耶的巨型战车形式，24个巨大石轮环绕底座，两侧是7匹骏马雕刻。精美的情爱浮雕使其与卡修拉霍齐名，1984年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Built in the 13th century, the Sun Temple at Konark is conceived as a colossal stone chariot of the sun god Surya, with 24 intricately carved wheels around the plinth and seven horses pulling it. Its exquisite erotic friezes rival Khajuraho. UNESCO-listed in 1984.

zh: 世界遗产
印度教神庙
奥里萨

location.zh: 奥里萨邦科纳克镇

zh: 24个石雕车轮，每轮直径约3米，兼具日晷功能
精美的雕刻涵盖神话场景、世俗生活与情爱主题
每年12月科纳克舞蹈节在神庙前举办，是印度最重要的古典舞蹈节之一
en: 24 stone chariot wheels, ~3 m diameter each, also function as sundials
Intricate carvings depicting mythological, everyday and erotic themes
Annual December Konark Dance Festival staged before the temple — one of India's premier classical dance events

admission.zh: 外国游客600卢比

tips.zh: 距普里约35公里，通常与普里海滩及林伽拉吉神庙（布巴内斯瓦尔）安排在同一奥里萨行程中。
tips.en: About 35 km from Puri — typically combined with Puri beach and Lingaraja Temple (Bhubaneswar) on an Odisha circuit.

description.zh: 亨比是14—16世纪维查耶纳伽罗帝国的首都遗址，在巨大花岗岩巨石的奇异地貌中散布着500余座庙宇、宫殿、集市和浴场遗址。维鲁帕克夏神庙至今仍在使用，1986年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Hampi is the ruined capital of the Vijayanagara Empire (14th–16th centuries), with over 500 temples, palaces, bazaars and baths scattered across a surreal boulder landscape. The Virupaksha Temple is still an active place of worship. UNESCO-listed in 1986.

zh: 世界遗产
帝国遗址
印度教建筑

location.zh: 卡纳塔克邦北部维贾亚纳加拉区

zh: 维鲁帕克夏神庙：50米高的节日塔（Gopuram），是亨比最具代表性的地标
胜利宫（维达拉神庙）：石战车和精美的柱厅
巨石群日落：站在山顶俯瞰橙色岩石与废墟的全景，是亨比最经典的体验
en: Virupaksha Temple: 50-metre gopuram tower, the iconic landmark of Hampi
Vittala Temple: the famous stone chariot and exquisitely carved musical columns
Boulder-top sunset: panoramic views of orange rocks and ruins — Hampi's quintessential experience

admission.zh: 外国游客600卢比（含多处主要遗址）

tips.zh: 在亨比租骑自行车或摩托车是游览分散遗址的最佳方式。旺季（10—2月）气候宜人，夏季酷热难耐。
tips.en: Rent a bicycle or motorbike in Hampi to cover the spread-out ruins. October–February is ideal; summers are brutally hot.

description.zh: 法塔赫布尔·西格里是阿克巴大帝于1569年建造的莫卧儿帝国新都，但因供水不足仅使用约15年便被遗弃，成为一座保存完整的「幽灵城市」。皇宫、清真寺与庭院建筑群于1986年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Fatehpur Sikri was Akbar's newly built Mughal capital in 1569, abandoned after barely 15 years due to water scarcity, leaving an extraordinarily intact 'ghost city'. The palace-mosque-courtyard complex was UNESCO-listed in 1986.

zh: 世界遗产
莫卧儿建筑
废弃古城

location.zh: 北方邦阿格拉区法塔赫布尔·西格里镇
location.en: Fatehpur Sikri, Agra District, Uttar Pradesh

zh: 胜利门（布兰德·达瓦扎）：世界最高清真寺门之一，高54米
五层宫（潘奇·马哈尔）：5层无支柱的开放式宫殿，每层有54根石柱
整座城市红色砂岩建造，印度教与伊斯兰建筑风格完美融合
en: Buland Darwaza (Gate of Victory): one of the world's tallest mosque gateways at 54 m
Panch Mahal: a 5-storey open palace supported by 176 columns with no walls
Entire city in red sandstone, harmoniously blending Hindu and Islamic architectural styles

admission.zh: 外国游客610卢比

tips.zh: 距阿格拉约40公里，通常作为前往斋普尔途中的途经景点游览。参观圣墓（Dargah Salim Chishti）时须脱鞋。
tips.en: About 40 km from Agra — often visited en route to Jaipur. Remove shoes before entering the Dargah of Salim Chishti shrine.

description.zh: 卡济兰加国家公园是世界上最大的印度单角犀牛种群栖息地，全球三分之二的单角犀牛生活于此。同时也是孟加拉虎、亚洲大象、野水牛的重要保护区，1985年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Kaziranga National Park in Assam harbours two-thirds of the world's Indian one-horned rhinoceroses — the largest population of this species on Earth. The park is also a crucial refuge for Bengal tigers, Asian elephants and wild water buffaloes. UNESCO-listed in 1985.

zh: 世界遗产
野生动物
国家公园

location.zh: 阿萨姆邦戈拉哈特区及那加翁区
location.en: Golaghat and Nagaon Districts, Assam, India

zh: 2,200余头单角犀牛，全球最大种群
象背观赏犀牛：清晨骑大象穿越芦苇草原是标志性体验
超过400种鸟类，包括大量候鸟
en: Over 2,200 one-horned rhinos — the world's largest population
Elephant-back rhino safari at dawn: an iconic and unforgettable experience
Over 400 bird species, including major migratory populations

admission.zh: 外国游客野生动物保护费约100卢比；吉普车游猎约3,000—5,000卢比，象背游猎约1,000卢比
admission.en: Foreign visitors wildlife fee ~₹100; jeep safari ₹3,000–5,000; elephant safari ~₹1,000

tips.zh: 最佳游览季节为11月至4月，5—10月季风期公园关闭。距古瓦哈提约220公里，可乘火车或飞机到达。
tips.en: Best November–April; park closes May–October (monsoon). About 220 km from Guwahati — reach by train or fly to Jorhat.

name.zh: 马纳斯野生动物保护区

description.zh: 马纳斯野生动物保护区位于阿萨姆邦与不丹边境的丘陵地带，以河流草甸、常绿丛林和野生动物的多样性著称，是世界上少数同时被列为UNESCO世界遗产、老虎保护区和生物圈保护区的地点，1985年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Manas Wildlife Sanctuary on the Assam-Bhutan foothills is celebrated for its river grasslands, evergreen forests and remarkable wildlife diversity. One of the few sites simultaneously designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, Tiger Reserve and Biosphere Reserve. UNESCO-listed in 1985.

zh: 世界遗产
野生动物
生物圈保护区

location.zh: 阿萨姆邦巴克萨区

zh: 印度特有的金色兰格尔（Golden Langur）栖息地
孟加拉虎、大象、大犀鸟等旗舰物种
马纳斯河：不丹高山融雪而成的清澈河流，漂流体验绝佳
en: Key habitat for the endemic Golden Langur, found nowhere else in India
Bengal tiger, elephant and Great Hornbill among flagship species
Manas River: crystal-clear glacial stream from Bhutan — excellent for rafting

admission.zh: 外国游客入园费约1,500卢比；含向导的吉普车游猎另计
admission.en: Foreign visitors entry ~₹1,500; guided jeep safari additional

tips.zh: 旺季11月至4月，距古瓦哈提约176公里。游览须有持证向导陪同，可在马纳斯镇安排。
tips.en: Best November–April; 176 km from Guwahati. A licensed guide is compulsory — arrange through operators in Manas town.

description.zh: 桑德尔本斯是世界上最大的红树林生态系统，横跨印孟两国，印度侧于1987年列入UNESCO世界遗产。这片潮汐沼泽森林是孟加拉虎的重要保护区，老虎已完全适应水中生活，是世界上唯一能游泳的老虎种群。
description.en: The Sundarbans is the world's largest mangrove ecosystem, straddling India and Bangladesh. The Indian section was UNESCO-listed in 1987. This tidal delta forest is a critical tiger refuge — the only tiger population in the world adapted to swimming in salt water.

zh: 世界遗产
红树林
孟加拉虎

location.zh: 西孟加拉邦南24帕尔加纳斯区
location.en: South 24 Parganas District, West Bengal, India

zh: 世界最大红树林，迷宫般的水道与岛屿
能游泳的孟加拉虎，世界上唯一适应咸水环境的老虎
乘船穿越红树林水道，欣赏咸水鳄鱼和各种水鸟
en: World's largest mangrove forest, a labyrinth of tidal channels and islands
Swimming Bengal tigers — the only tiger population adapted to a saline environment
Boat safaris through mangrove creeks for saltwater crocodiles and waterbirds

admission.zh: 外国游客入园费约1,000卢比；须乘船进入

tips.zh: 从加尔各答的戈德卡利出发乘船约4小时到达主要游览区。最佳季节为10—3月。必须参加当地认证的游船，独自进入非常危险。
tips.en: About 4 hours by boat from Godkhali (near Kolkata). Best October–March. Always use a licensed boat — venturing alone is extremely dangerous.

name.zh: 南达·德维国家公园与花谷
name.en: Nanda Devi and Valley of Flowers National Parks

description.zh: 南达·德维国家公园以印度第二高峰（7,816米）为核心，与旁侧的「花谷」国家公园共同构成世界上最壮观的高山生态系统之一，谷中夏季盛开数百种喜马拉雅野花。1988年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Nanda Devi National Park surrounds India's second-highest peak (7,816 m) and shares its buffer zone with the Valley of Flowers — one of the world's most spectacular alpine ecosystems, carpeted with hundreds of Himalayan wildflower species each summer. UNESCO-listed in 1988.

zh: 世界遗产
高山生态
喜马拉雅

location.zh: 北阿坎德邦恰莫利区

zh: 花谷：7—8月数百种喜马拉雅野花竞相盛开的高山仙境
南达·德维峰（7,816米）是印度境内第二高峰
雪豹、喜马拉雅棕熊、金雕等稀有野生动物
en: Valley of Flowers: a Himalayan paradise carpeted with hundreds of wildflower species in July–August
Nanda Devi (7,816 m): India's second-highest peak, visible from multiple viewpoints
Snow leopard, Himalayan brown bear and golden eagle among the rare wildlife

admission.zh: 外国游客花谷入园费约600卢比；南达·德维核心区不对公众开放
admission.en: Valley of Flowers foreign entry ~₹600; Nanda Devi core zone closed to public

duration.zh: 花谷徒步：戈文德加特出发，2—3天往返
duration.en: Valley of Flowers trek: 2–3 days return from Govindghat

tips.zh: 花谷仅夏季（6—10月）开放，最佳时节为7—8月野花盛放。从德里到戈文德加特约500公里，须乘长途汽车或自驾。
tips.en: Valley of Flowers is open June–October only; peak wildflower season is July–August. About 500 km from Delhi to Govindghat by road.

description.zh: 桑奇是保存最完整的古代佛教建筑遗址之一，大塔（Great Stupa）建于公元前3世纪阿育王时代，四座精雕细琢的石制山门（Torana）装饰有佛陀本生故事的完整浮雕图像。1989年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Sanchi is one of the finest surviving examples of early Buddhist architecture. The Great Stupa dates to the 3rd century BCE Mauryan Emperor Ashoka, and its four elaborately carved gateways (toranas) depict the complete cycle of Jataka tales. UNESCO-listed in 1989.

zh: 世界遗产
佛教
阿育王时代

location.zh: 中央邦博帕尔区桑奇镇

zh: 大塔：阿育王时代建造，直径约36米的半球形佛塔
四座山门（Torana）：精美浮雕讲述佛陀本生故事
桑奇博物馆：展示从遗址出土的大量早期佛教文物
en: Great Stupa: 36-metre diameter Mauryan-era hemisphere, the oldest surviving stupa in India
Four toranas: intricately carved gateways narrating Jataka stories
Sanchi Museum: extensive collection of early Buddhist artefacts from the site

admission.zh: 外国游客600卢比（含博物馆）

tips.zh: 距博帕尔约46公里，有火车和公交可到达。建议与博帕尔博物馆和人类博物馆安排在同一行程。
tips.en: About 46 km from Bhopal by train or bus. Combine with Bhopal's State Museum and Tribal Museum for a full-day itinerary.

description.zh: 胡马雍陵是莫卧儿帝国第一座大规模陵墓建筑，建于1570年，被视为泰姬陵的前身。庄严的双层穹顶、几何式花园（查尔巴格）和红色砂岩与白色大理石的搭配确立了莫卧儿建筑的经典风格。1993年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Humayun's Tomb (1570) was the first grand Mughal funerary monument and the direct precursor to the Taj Mahal. Its double dome, formal char bagh (four-part garden) and red sandstone-and-white marble palette defined the canonical Mughal architectural style. UNESCO-listed in 1993.

zh: 世界遗产
莫卧儿建筑
新德里

location.zh: 德里尼扎姆丁区

zh: 波斯设计师监造的印度次大陆第一座双层穹顶建筑
查尔巴格（四分花园）：完整的莫卧儿几何式庭园
修复后的庭园环境堪称德里最美的绿洲之一
en: India's first double-domed mausoleum, designed by a Persian architect
Char bagh (four-part garden): the complete Mughal formal garden in pristine condition
Beautifully restored garden complex — one of Delhi's most serene green spaces

admission.zh: 外国游客600卢比

tips.zh: 距尼扎姆丁火车站仅5分钟步行，可与附近的尼扎姆丁圣祠安排在同一下午游览。
tips.en: Just 5 minutes' walk from Hazrat Nizamuddin railway station. Combine with the nearby Nizamuddin Dargah shrine for an enriching afternoon.

description.zh: 顾特卜塔是印度最高的砖砌宣礼塔，高72.5米，建于1193年。塔周围的顾特卜建筑群包含印度最早的清真寺（顾瓦特伊斯兰清真寺）和一根矗立超过1,600年的铁柱（几乎无锈蚀）。1993年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: The 72.5-metre Qutb Minar is India's tallest brick minaret, built in 1193. The surrounding complex includes India's oldest mosque (Quwwat-ul-Islam) and a 1,600-year-old iron pillar that has barely rusted. UNESCO-listed in 1993.

zh: 世界遗产
伊斯兰建筑
新德里

location.zh: 德里梅赫劳利区

zh: 顾特卜塔：72.5米，印度最高砖砌宣礼塔，每层刻有可兰经文
铁柱：公元4世纪铸造，历1,600余年几乎无锈，冶金史上的奇迹
顾瓦特伊斯兰清真寺：印度次大陆最早建造的清真寺遗址
en: Qutb Minar: 72.5 m, India's tallest brick minaret with Quranic inscriptions on each storey
Iron Pillar: cast in the 4th century CE, barely rusted after 1,600 years — a metallurgical marvel
Quwwat-ul-Islam Mosque: ruins of the first mosque built in the Indian subcontinent

admission.zh: 外国游客600卢比

tips.zh: 德里地铁黄线顾特卜塔站步行约10分钟可到，是德里最便捷到达的UNESCO遗址之一。
tips.en: About 10 minutes' walk from Qutb Minar Metro station (Yellow Line) — one of Delhi's most conveniently accessible UNESCO sites.

description.zh: 印度山地铁路包含三条19—20世纪修建的高山窄轨铁路：大吉岭喜马拉雅铁路、尼尔吉里山铁路和卡尔卡-西姆拉铁路。三条铁路以工程创意和对殖民时代山区经济的重要性，分期列入UNESCO世界遗产（1999—2008年）。
description.en: India's Mountain Railways comprise three 19th–20th-century narrow-gauge hill railways: Darjeeling Himalayan Railway, Nilgiri Mountain Railway and Kalka-Shimla Railway. They were inscribed in phases for their engineering ingenuity and colonial-era economic significance (1999–2008).

zh: 世界遗产
山地铁路
殖民时代

location.zh: 大吉岭（西孟加拉）、尼尔吉里（泰米尔纳德）、西姆拉（喜马偕尔邦）
location.en: Darjeeling (West Bengal), Nilgiris (Tamil Nadu), Shimla (Himachal Pradesh)

zh: 大吉岭喜马拉雅铁路：「玩具火车」蒸汽机车穿越茶园梯田，远望干城章嘉峰
尼尔吉里山铁路：单轨齿轮铁路蜿蜒穿越茶园与热带雨林
卡尔卡-西姆拉铁路：102座隧道和约900座桥梁，全程风景壮观
en: Darjeeling Himalayan Railway: 'Toy Train' steam engine through tea gardens with views of Kangchenjunga
Nilgiri Mountain Railway: rack-and-pinion system winding through tea estates and rainforest
Kalka-Shimla Railway: 102 tunnels and ~900 bridges along a spectacular mountain route

admission.zh: 火车票约100—500卢比，视线路和席别而定
admission.en: Train tickets ~₹100–500 depending on route and class

duration.zh: 单程约3—5小时（各条铁路不同）
duration.en: 3–5 hours one-way depending on the route

tips.zh: 大吉岭玩具火车是最受欢迎的一段，建议提前在IRCTC官网购票；旺季非常紧张。
tips.en: The Darjeeling Toy Train is the most popular section — book ahead on the IRCTC website; seats sell out fast during peak season.

name.en: Mahabodhi Temple Complex at Bodh Gaya

description.zh: 菩提伽耶是佛陀悉达多在菩提树下证悟的地方，也是世界上最重要的佛教圣地。摩诃菩提寺建于公元5—6世纪，高约55米的主塔直指云天，旁侧的菩提树（原树的后代）至今枝繁叶茂。2002年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Bodh Gaya is where the Buddha attained enlightenment under the Bodhi Tree — the most sacred place in Buddhism. The Mahabodhi Temple, built in the 5th–6th century CE, rises 55 metres beside the direct descendant of the original Bodhi Tree. UNESCO-listed in 2002.

zh: 世界遗产
佛教圣地
朝圣

location.zh: 比哈尔邦伽耶区菩提伽耶镇
location.en: Bodh Gaya, Gaya District, Bihar, India

zh: 菩提树：佛陀证悟的菩提树之后代，树龄逾百年
55米高的主塔：迦腻色迦时代风格的早期佛教建筑精品
来自世界各地佛教信众的晨昏诵经，氛围庄严祥和
en: Bodhi Tree: a direct descendant of the tree under which the Buddha attained enlightenment
55-metre main shrine tower: a masterwork of early Buddhist temple architecture
Pilgrims from every Buddhist tradition worldwide chanting at dawn and dusk

admission.zh: 外国游客300卢比

tips.zh: 建议清晨或黄昏参观，气氛最为庄严肃穆。伽耶机场直达，可配合王舍城（Rajgir）和那烂陀安排佛教朝圣之旅。
tips.en: Visit at dawn or dusk for the most spiritual atmosphere. Gaya airport is nearby; combine with Rajgir and Nalanda for a complete Buddhist pilgrimage circuit.

description.zh: 宾贝特卡岩洞群包含逾750处岩洞，最早的岩画可追溯至10万年前，展示了从旧石器时代到中世纪的连续人类居住和艺术活动，是南亚保存最好的史前岩画遗址。2003年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Bhimbetka's 750+ rock shelters contain paintings dating back 100,000 years, documenting unbroken human occupation and artistic activity from the Palaeolithic to the medieval period — the finest prehistoric rock art site in South Asia. UNESCO-listed in 2003.

zh: 世界遗产
史前岩画
旧石器时代

location.zh: 中央邦博帕尔以南约45公里
location.en: Raisen District, Madhya Pradesh, about 45 km south of Bhopal

zh: 最古老的岩画达10万年历史，描绘狩猎、舞蹈、动物等场景
「动物岩洞」（Zoo Rock）：色彩鲜艳的动物群像画面
溪谷中的文圆形花岗岩巨石，本身就是壮观的自然景观
en: Paintings up to 100,000 years old depicting hunting, dancing and animals in vivid ochre and red
'Zoo Rock': a densely painted panel of animals, one of the most celebrated images
The spherical sandstone boulders in forested valleys are a dramatic natural spectacle

admission.zh: 外国游客600卢比

tips.zh: 距博帕尔约45公里，公共交通较不便，建议包车前往。与桑奇安排在同一天效率最高。
tips.en: About 45 km from Bhopal — public transport is infrequent, hire a car. Most efficiently combined with Sanchi in the same day trip.

name.zh: 占帕内尔-帕瓦加德考古公园

description.zh: 占帕内尔是15—16世纪古吉拉特苏丹国首都，至今保存着从前伊斯兰时代到莫卧儿时代的寺庙、清真寺、宫殿和要塞遗址。帕瓦加德山顶的卡利卡·马塔神庙是古吉拉特最重要的朝圣地。2004年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Champaner was the 15th–16th-century capital of the Gujarat Sultanate. The archaeological park preserves temples, mosques, palaces and fortifications from pre-Islamic to Mughal periods. The Kalikamata Temple atop Pavagadh hill is Gujarat's most important pilgrimage site. UNESCO-listed in 2004.

zh: 世界遗产
古吉拉特苏丹国
考古遗址

location.zh: 古吉拉特邦潘奇摩哈尔区

zh: 贾玛清真寺：古吉拉特苏丹国最精美的清真寺，融合印度教与伊斯兰风格
帕瓦加德山（830米）：乘坐缆车登顶朝拜卡利卡·马塔神庙
保存完整的苏丹国城市遗址，几乎未曾被现代建设破坏
en: Jama Masjid: the Gujarat Sultanate's finest mosque, elegantly blending Hindu and Islamic elements
Pavagadh hill (830 m): take the ropeway to the pilgrimage summit shrine
Remarkably intact Sultanate-era urban remains, undisturbed by modern development

admission.zh: 外国游客600卢比

tips.zh: 距巴罗达（瓦多达拉）约47公里，可乘火车或巴士前往。与巴罗达博物馆安排在同一行程最为高效。
tips.en: About 47 km from Vadodara (Baroda) by bus or train. Combine with Vadodara Museum for an efficient itinerary.

name.zh: 贾特拉帕蒂·希瓦吉终点站

description.zh: 贾特拉帕蒂·希瓦吉终点站（旧称维多利亚终点站，VT）建于1887年，是维多利亚·高迪克复兴风格与印度传统建筑风格完美融合的典范。至今仍是孟买最繁忙的铁路枢纽，日均客流量达350万人次。2004年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (formerly Victoria Terminus, VT), built in 1887, is a stunning fusion of High Victorian Gothic Revival and traditional Indian architecture. Still Mumbai's busiest railway hub with 3.5 million daily passengers. UNESCO-listed in 2004.

zh: 世界遗产
维多利亚建筑
孟买

location.zh: 马哈拉施特拉邦孟买

zh: 维多利亚哥特复兴风格与印度传统建筑元素的史诗级融合
圆顶、角楼与精美石雕，是殖民时代孟买的精华代表
至今仍是运营中的铁路车站，功能与历史文化价值并重
en: Epic fusion of High Victorian Gothic Revival with Indian architectural motifs
Domes, turrets and intricate stone carvings — the finest example of colonial Mumbai
Still a fully operational railway station, seamlessly blending heritage and daily life

admission.zh: 外观免费；内部须购买专项参观票（约100卢比）

tips.zh: 建议在购买火车票等候期间欣赏建筑；对面的旧孟买市政大楼同样为世界遗产的一部分，值得一看。
tips.en: The building is best appreciated while waiting for trains or on a walking tour of Fort area. The old Municipal Corporation Building opposite is part of the same Victorian heritage ensemble.

description.zh: 果阿的教堂与修道院群是葡萄牙在亚洲殖民传教的重要见证，包含仁慈耶稣圣殿（珍藏圣方济各·沙勿略遗体）、大教堂等8处16—17世纪巴洛克建筑，展示了基督教在亚洲的扩展历程。1986年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Goa's churches and convents are outstanding witnesses to Portuguese colonial evangelism in Asia, comprising eight 16th–17th-century Baroque buildings including the Basilica of Bom Jesus (housing the relics of St Francis Xavier) and Se Cathedral. UNESCO-listed in 1986.

zh: 世界遗产
葡式巴洛克
天主教

location.zh: 果阿邦旧果阿镇（东果阿区）
location.en: Old Goa, East Goa District, Goa, India

zh: 仁慈耶稣圣殿：珍藏圣方济各·沙勿略不腐遗体，每10年开放朝圣
大教堂（Sé Cathedral）：亚洲最大的天主教教堂之一
旧果阿整片教堂群，与周边热带植被形成独特景观
en: Basilica of Bom Jesus: contains the incorrupt relics of St Francis Xavier, exposed every ten years
Se Cathedral: one of the largest Catholic churches in Asia
The cluster of white-washed Baroque churches amid tropical greenery creates an unmistakable atmosphere

admission.zh: 教堂外观及内部免费；部分博物馆收费
admission.en: Churches free; some attached museums charge a small fee

tips.zh: 旧果阿距帕纳吉（果阿首府）约10公里，巴士和出租车均可到达。圣方济各圣迹展览（2024—2025年）是难得一见的朝圣盛事。
tips.en: Old Goa is about 10 km from Panaji (Goa's capital) by bus or taxi. The Exposition of St Francis Xavier's relics (2024–2025) is a once-in-a-decade pilgrim event.

name.zh: 斋浦尔简塔曼塔天文台

description.zh: 简塔曼塔是18世纪斋浦尔君主萨瓦伊·贾伊·辛格二世于1734年建造的大型天文观测台，拥有19架砖石和大理石制成的天文仪器，能以肉眼精确测量时间、预测日食及追踪天体运动。2010年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Jantar Mantar is a collection of 19 astronomical instruments built in 1734 by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II of Jaipur. The stone-and-marble devices can measure local time to within two seconds, predict eclipses and track celestial bodies with the naked eye. UNESCO-listed in 2010.

zh: 世界遗产
天文台
拉贾斯坦

location.zh: 拉贾斯坦邦斋浦尔市宫殿路
location.en: Palace Road, Jaipur City, Rajasthan, India

zh: 萨姆拉特扬特拉（大日晷）：世界上最大的日晷，高27米，精度误差仅2秒
19架各具功能的天文仪器组成，形成奇异的几何景观
紧邻城市宫殿（Hawa Mahal步行可达），便于行程整合
en: Samrat Yantra (Great Gnomon): world's largest sundial at 27 m height, accurate to 2 seconds
19 instruments each with a specific astronomical function, forming a surreal geometric landscape
Adjacent to City Palace and a short walk from Hawa Mahal — easy to include in a Jaipur day

admission.zh: 外国游客200卢比（含导览）

tips.zh: 斋浦尔城市宫殿、风之宫殿和简塔曼塔可安排在同一上午游览，均在旧城核心区步行范围内。
tips.en: City Palace, Hawa Mahal and Jantar Mantar can all be covered in the same morning — all are within easy walking distance in the old city core.

description.zh: 西高止山脉沿印度西部海岸延伸约1,600公里，被认为是全球生物多样性最丰富的热点地区之一。39处组成遗址涵盖热带湿润林、常绿森林和沼泽地，栖息着5,000余种开花植物、139种哺乳类及508种鸟类。2012年列入UNESCO世界自然遗产。
description.en: The Western Ghats stretch 1,600 km along India's western coast and are one of the world's eight biodiversity hotspots. The 39-site serial property encompasses tropical wet forests, evergreen forests and swamps, harbouring 5,000+ flowering plant species, 139 mammal and 508 bird species. UNESCO Natural Heritage since 2012.

zh: 世界遗产
自然遗产
生物多样性热点

location.zh: 喀拉拉邦、泰米尔纳德邦、卡纳塔克邦、马哈拉施特拉邦及果阿邦
location.en: Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Maharashtra and Goa

zh: 穆纳尔（Munnar）茶园梯田：喀拉拉邦高山茶园的代表景观
科达古（Coorg）：咖啡园与云雾森林，是野生大象常见之处
西高止山脉是亚洲狮尾猕猴等众多特有物种的最后避难所
en: Munnar tea terraces: the iconic high-altitude tea landscape of Kerala
Coorg: coffee plantations and misty forests where wild elephants roam
Last refuge for numerous endemic species including the Lion-tailed Macaque

admission.zh: 各保护区入园费不同，约50—500卢比

duration.zh: 建议选择2—3个地点，各游2—3天

tips.zh: 西高止山脉延绵各州，建议根据旅行线路选择穆纳尔（喀拉拉）、科达古（卡纳塔克）或尼尔吉里（泰米尔纳德）其中之一深度游览。
tips.en: The Ghats span multiple states — choose one focus area per trip: Munnar (Kerala), Coorg (Karnataka) or the Nilgiris (Tamil Nadu) each offer a distinct and rewarding experience.

description.zh: 拉贾斯坦丘陵堡垒群包含6座8—18世纪拉杰普特王国在丘陵顶部建造的雄伟要塞：琥珀堡、奇陶尔加尔堡、甘格隆堡、贾萨尔默堡、昆巴尔加尔堡和兰坦波尔堡。这些堡垒展示了独特的军事建筑与繁盛的宫廷文化。2013年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: The six Hill Forts of Rajasthan — Amber, Chittorgarh, Gagron, Jaisalmer, Kumbhalgarh and Ranthambore — built by Rajput kingdoms between the 8th and 18th centuries, exemplify distinctive military architecture and a flourishing court culture. UNESCO-listed in 2013.

zh: 世界遗产
拉杰普特建筑
拉贾斯坦

location.zh: 拉贾斯坦邦（斋浦尔、奇陶尔加尔、贾萨尔默等地）
location.en: Various locations across Rajasthan (Jaipur, Chittorgarh, Jaisalmer, etc.)

zh: 贾萨尔默堡：「黄金堡」，世界上少数仍有居民居住的古堡之一
奇陶尔加尔堡：全印度面积最大的山顶要塞，多段悲壮历史的发生地
昆巴尔加尔堡：城墙绵延达36公里，被称为「印度的长城」
en: Jaisalmer Fort: the 'Golden Fort', one of the world's few living forts still inhabited by thousands of residents
Chittorgarh Fort: India's largest hill fortress, site of legendary episodes of Rajput resistance
Kumbhalgarh Fort: 36 km of walls — dubbed 'the Great Wall of India'

admission.zh: 各堡垒外国游客票价约300—600卢比

duration.zh: 每座堡垒半天至一天，全部游览需4—7天
duration.en: Half to full day per fort; visiting all six requires 4–7 days across Rajasthan

tips.zh: 贾萨尔默堡内住宿体验独特，但购物须谨慎防骗。奇陶尔加尔是公路旅行途经的理想停靠点。
tips.en: Staying inside Jaisalmer Fort is a memorable experience, but be cautious of tourist scams in the bazaars. Chittorgarh makes an ideal road-trip stop between Udaipur and Jaipur.

name.zh: 拉尼·基·瓦夫（王后阶梯井）

description.zh: 拉尼·基·瓦夫建于11世纪，是印度最精美的阶梯井建筑，七层深达30米的阶梯走廊四壁雕有逾500座佛像和神像，被称为「颠倒的神庙」。沉埋地下数百年后于20世纪被挖掘，2014年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Built in the 11th century, Rani-ki-Vav is India's most elaborate stepwell. Seven storeys descend 30 metres, with over 500 principal sculptures and 1,000 minor carvings adorning the walls — an 'inverted temple'. Buried for centuries and excavated in the 20th century. UNESCO-listed in 2014.

zh: 世界遗产
阶梯井
古吉拉特

location.zh: 古吉拉特邦帕坦市

zh: 七层阶梯深达30米，是印度最复杂的阶梯井结构
逾500座主雕像，描绘毗湿奴与其化身，雕刻精绝
印度100卢比钞票背面的图案即为此处
en: Seven storeys descending 30 metres — India's most complex stepwell structure
Over 500 principal sculptures depicting Vishnu and his avatars in extraordinary detail
Featured on the reverse of India's ₹100 banknote

admission.zh: 外国游客600卢比

tips.zh: 帕坦距艾哈迈达巴德约120公里，可乘火车约2小时到达。同日可顺游帕坦精美的帕托拉织物工坊。
tips.en: Patan is about 120 km from Ahmedabad (~2 hours by train). Combine with a visit to a Patan Patola silk weaving workshop in the same day trip.

description.zh: 大喜马拉雅国家公园位于西喜马拉雅的喜马偕尔邦库鲁区，保护着大量珍稀高山生态系统，包含雪豹、喜马拉雅鬃羊（塔尔羊）、蓝羊（岩羊）及数百种鸟类。2014年列入UNESCO世界自然遗产。
description.en: The Great Himalayan National Park in Kullu District, Himachal Pradesh protects a remarkable range of western Himalayan alpine ecosystems and is home to snow leopards, Himalayan tahr, blue sheep and hundreds of bird species. UNESCO Natural Heritage since 2014.

zh: 世界遗产
自然遗产
喜马拉雅

location.zh: 喜马偕尔邦库鲁区

zh: 雪豹：海拔3,000—5,000米的高山区域是雪豹的重要栖息地
多条徒步路线穿越壮阔的高山草甸、冰川和原始森林
提尔森（Tirthan）河谷：生态旅游基地，钓鱼和徒步的胜地
en: Snow leopard: the alpine zone 3,000–5,000 m above sea level is critical leopard habitat
Multiple trekking routes through spectacular alpine meadows, glaciers and pristine forest
Tirthan Valley: the eco-tourism gateway — excellent for fishing and hiking

admission.zh: 外国游客入园费约200卢比；须持有领取的许可证

duration.en: Minimum 2 days; 5–7 days for serious trekking

tips.zh: 核心区只有在授权向导带领下方可进入。最近城市为库鲁/马纳利，6—9月最佳游览季节。
tips.en: Core zone entry requires a licensed guide. Nearest town is Kullu/Manali. Best June–September; core zone treks require advance permits.

description.zh: 那烂陀寺是公元5至12世纪世界上最伟大的佛教学习中心，鼎盛时期有逾10,000名学僧来自亚洲各地。现存的砖制修道院、塔庙和寺院遗址展示了佛教高等教育的辉煌历史。2016年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Nalanda Mahavihara was the world's greatest centre of Buddhist learning from the 5th to 12th centuries, at its peak hosting over 10,000 monks from across Asia. The surviving brick monasteries, stupas and temples document the grandeur of Buddhist higher education. UNESCO-listed in 2016.

zh: 世界遗产
佛教大学
比哈尔

location.zh: 比哈尔邦那烂陀区（菩提伽耶以北约90公里）
location.en: Nalanda District, Bihar, India (about 90 km north of Bodh Gaya)

zh: 公元5—12世纪世界最大佛教大学，记载在中国唐代玄奘法师《大唐西域记》中
庞大的砖制寺院、塔楼与庭院遗址，仍可感受昔日规模
那烂陀博物馆：丰富的出土文物与早期佛教艺术收藏
en: World's greatest Buddhist university (5th–12th century CE), documented by Tang-dynasty monk Xuanzang
Vast red-brick monastery ruins, stupas and courtyards that still convey the original scale
Nalanda Museum: rich collection of excavated artefacts and early Buddhist art

admission.zh: 外国游客600卢比（含博物馆）

tips.zh: 从菩提伽耶出发的佛教朝圣线路必经之地，可与王舍城（Rajgir）安排在同一天。距巴特那约95公里。
tips.en: An essential stop on the Buddhist pilgrimage circuit from Bodh Gaya. Combine with Rajgir in the same day trip. About 95 km from Patna.

description.zh: 干城章嘉国家公园包围着世界第三高峰干城章嘉峰（8,586米），是西克金邦的精神与文化核心。园内涵盖冰川、高山湖泊、喜马拉雅冷杉林与多种珍稀高山物种，也是世界上首个被认定为混合遗产（自然+文化）的印度遗址。2016年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Khangchendzonga National Park encompasses Kangchenjunga, the world's third-highest peak (8,586 m), and is the spiritual and cultural heart of Sikkim. Glaciers, alpine lakes, Himalayan fir forests and rare high-altitude species define this landscape — India's first UNESCO Mixed Heritage site. UNESCO-listed in 2016.

zh: 世界遗产
混合遗产
喜马拉雅

location.zh: 西克金邦北部及西北部

zh: 干城章嘉峰（8,586米）：世界第三高峰，西克金守护神的化身
大量冰川、冰碛湖与高山草甸，景色极为壮观
可在甘托克或佩林一带欣赏雪山日出，无需进入保护区核心
en: Kangchenjunga (8,586 m): world's third-highest peak, revered as Sikkim's guardian deity
Extensive glaciers, moraine lakes and alpine meadows of extraordinary scenic grandeur
Sunrise views over the snow peaks from Gangtok or Pelling — no park entry required

admission.zh: 国家公园入园须持许可证；甘托克观景台免费
admission.en: Park entry requires a permit; Gangtok viewpoints free

tips.zh: 外国游客进入西克金须持「受保护地区许可证」（PAP），在甘托克、西里古里或加尔各答均可办理。10月底至11月初晴天最多，视野最佳。
tips.en: Foreign visitors need a Protected Area Permit (PAP) for Sikkim — obtainable in Gangtok, Siliguri or Kolkata. Late October–early November offers the clearest weather and mountain views.

name.zh: 勒·柯布西耶的建筑作品——昌迪加尔
name.en: The Architectural Work of Le Corbusier — Chandigarh

description.zh: 昌迪加尔是独立后印度的第一座全新规划城市（1950年代），由勒·柯布西耶主导设计，其议会大厦、秘书处和高等法院构成气势恢宏的「首都建筑群」，是20世纪现代主义城市规划的里程碑。作为全球17处柯布西耶建筑之一，2016年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Chandigarh was independent India's first purpose-planned city (1950s), master-planned by Le Corbusier. His Capitol Complex — comprising the Assembly, Secretariat and High Court — is a landmark of 20th-century Modernist urbanism. One of 17 Le Corbusier works worldwide, UNESCO-listed in 2016.

zh: 世界遗产
勒·柯布西耶
现代建筑

location.zh: 昌迪加尔联邦直辖区（旁遮普邦及哈里亚纳邦首府）
location.en: Chandigarh Union Territory (capital of Punjab and Haryana)

zh: 议会大厦：冷却塔形态的议会厅，混凝土与光影的杰作
高等法院：色彩斑斓的遮阳板（Brise-Soleil）成为建筑标志
秘书处：长达255米的粗野主义行政长廊
en: Assembly Building: the hyperbolic cooling tower chamber — Le Corbusier's concrete masterpiece
High Court: colourful brise-soleil sunshades are the architectural signature

admission.zh: 首都建筑群外观免费；部分建筑内部须预约或须有访客通行证
admission.en: Capitol Complex exteriors free; some interiors require advance appointment or visitor pass

tips.zh: 从德里乘高铁约3小时，可以轻松安排日归。昌迪加尔建筑与设计博物馆（CAD）提供专业导览。岩石花园（Rock Garden）是另一处必游的奇异景点。
tips.en: About 3 hours from Delhi by fast train — doable as a day trip. The Chandigarh College of Architecture Museum (CAD) offers professional tours. The eccentric Rock Garden is another must-visit nearby.

name.zh: 艾哈迈达巴德历史城区

description.zh: 艾哈迈达巴德建于15世纪初，是古吉拉特苏丹国的首都，保存有大量精美的清真寺、印度教庙宇、耆那教庙宇和传统聚居建筑（波尔）。2017年成为印度首个被列入UNESCO世界遗产的历史城市。
description.en: Founded in the early 15th century as capital of the Gujarat Sultanate, Ahmedabad preserves a remarkable ensemble of mosques, Hindu and Jain temples, and traditional residential neighbourhoods (pols). In 2017 it became India's first city to receive UNESCO World Heritage City status.

zh: 世界遗产
历史城市
古吉拉特

location.zh: 古吉拉特邦艾哈迈达巴德市（旧城区）

zh: 波尔（Pol）聚居区：曲折小巷与精雕木制门楼的传统社区
贾玛清真寺（1423年）：古吉拉特苏丹国建筑的代表作
圣地达达·哈里尔清真寺与阶梯井：精美的格子雕刻令人叹为观止
en: Pol neighbourhoods: labyrinthine lanes lined with elaborately carved wooden havelis
Jama Masjid (1423): the masterpiece of Gujarat Sultanate mosque architecture
Sidi Saiyyed Mosque's lattice stone windows: the most celebrated stone jali (lattice) carvings in India

admission.zh: 大多数清真寺和公共区域免费
admission.en: Most mosques and public areas free

tips.zh: 旧城区早晨步行游览最为舒适。遗产漫步地图可在旅游局免费索取。距帕坦（拉尼·基·瓦夫）约120公里，可安排联游。
tips.en: A morning heritage walk through the old city is the best introduction. Free walking maps from the tourist office. About 120 km from Patan (Rani-ki-Vav) — link the two for an efficient Gujarat heritage circuit.

name.zh: 孟买维多利亚哥特式与装饰艺术建筑群
name.en: Victorian Gothic and Art Deco Ensembles of Mumbai

description.zh: 孟买的椭圆形草地（Oval Maidan）两侧矗立着两组世界级建筑群：西侧的维多利亚哥特式市政建筑（19世纪）和东侧的装饰艺术风格建筑（20世纪初），形成独特的双重建筑景观，2018年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Flanking Mumbai's Oval Maidan are two world-class ensembles: Victorian Gothic civic buildings on the west (19th century) and one of the world's largest collections of Art Deco architecture on the east (early 20th century). This unique double ensemble was UNESCO-listed in 2018.

zh: 世界遗产
装饰艺术
孟买

location.zh: 马哈拉施特拉邦孟买南部（福特区及椭圆形草地）
location.en: South Mumbai, Fort district and Oval Maidan, Maharashtra

zh: 孟买大学图书馆与拉杰巴伊钟楼：维多利亚哥特式建筑的标志
椭圆形草地东侧：全球最大规模的装饰艺术住宅与商业建筑群之一
孟买高等法院：宏伟的维多利亚哥特式法院建筑
en: Mumbai University Library and Rajabai Clock Tower: icons of Victorian Gothic architecture
East Oval Maidan: one of the world's largest Art Deco residential and commercial ensembles
Bombay High Court: magnificent Victorian Gothic judicial building

admission.zh: 街道外观免费；部分建筑内部须预约
admission.en: Street views free; some building interiors require appointment

tips.zh: 「孟买遗产漫步」导览团每周末举行，是了解建筑历史的最佳方式。与贾特拉帕蒂·希瓦吉终点站安排在同一个福特区半日游中最为高效。
tips.en: Mumbai Heritage Walks run weekend guided tours — the best way to appreciate the architectural history. Most efficiently combined with Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus on a Fort district half-day walk.

description.zh: 多拉维拉是印度河文明（哈拉帕文明）中保存最完整的城市遗址之一，约5,000年历史，位于古吉拉特邦卡奇地区的荒漠岛屿上。精心规划的城市格局、复杂的供水系统和独特的文字标牌展示了高度发达的城市文明。2021年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Dholavira is one of the most complete and best-preserved cities of the Indus Valley (Harappan) Civilisation, approximately 5,000 years old, located on a desert island in Gujarat's Rann of Kutch. Its planned urban layout, sophisticated water management system and unique signboard inscription testify to an advanced urban civilisation. UNESCO-listed in 2021.

zh: 世界遗产
哈拉帕文明
印度河流域

location.zh: 古吉拉特邦卡奇区卡迪尔岛
location.en: Khadir Island, Kutch District, Gujarat, India

zh: 三层城市规划（城堡区、中城和下城）：印度河文明城市规划的典范
世界上最早的城市供水和排水系统之一（约公元前3000年）
著名的「多拉维拉铭文」：印度河文字的最大单件出土文物
en: Three-tiered city plan (citadel, middle town, lower town): a model of Indus Valley urban planning
One of the world's earliest urban water conservation and drainage systems (~3000 BCE)
The 'Dholavira signboard': the largest single object bearing Indus script ever found

admission.zh: 外国游客600卢比

tips.zh: 位置偏远，距艾哈迈达巴德约360公里，建议自驾或参加2—3天的卡奇地区包车游览，与白色沙漠（大兰）结合。最佳游览季节为10月至3月。
tips.en: Remote site — about 360 km from Ahmedabad. Best visited by car as part of a 2–3-day Kutch circuit combined with the Great Rann salt desert. October–March is the only practical season.

description.zh: 霍伊萨拉时代圣地包含贝卢尔、哈勒比德和索马纳特普拉三处12—13世纪建造的印度教神庙群。这些神庙以密布全身的精细石雕著称——从底部的大象和马匹浮雕带，到多层神龛中数以千计的神像，无一寸空白。2023年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: The Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas comprise three 12th–13th-century Hindu temple complexes at Belur, Halebidu and Somnathapura. These temples are celebrated for their unbroken surface of extraordinarily intricate stone carvings — from elephant and horse friezes at the base to thousands of deities in tiered niches. UNESCO-listed in 2023.

zh: 世界遗产
霍伊萨拉建筑
卡纳塔克

location.zh: 卡纳塔克邦哈桑区（贝卢尔、哈勒比德）及迈索尔区（索马纳特普拉）
location.en: Hassan District (Belur, Halebidu) and Mysuru District (Somnathapura), Karnataka

zh: 贝卢尔金纳斯瓦米神庙：200余位舞女（Madanika）雕像，每位姿态各异
哈勒比德双神庙：全印度雕刻最精美、密度最高的神庙外墙
索马纳特普拉：保存最完整的霍伊萨拉星形平面神庙
en: Belur Chennakeshava Temple: over 200 Madanika bracket figures, each in a unique pose
Halebidu twin temples: the most intricately and densely carved temple facades in India
Somnathapura: the best-preserved Hoysala star-plan temple

admission.zh: 外国游客各庙约600卢比

duration.zh: 哈桑周边两处神庙一天；加索马纳特普拉需两天
duration.en: One day for Belur and Halebidu; add Somnathapura for a second day

tips.zh: 哈桑是最方便的住宿基地，有火车和巴士从班加罗尔（约4小时）和迈索尔（约3小时）直达。索马纳特普拉距迈索尔约38公里，适合作为迈索尔的半日游。
tips.en: Hassan is the most convenient base, with trains and buses from Bengaluru (~4 hours) and Mysuru (~3 hours). Somnathapura is 38 km from Mysuru — perfect as a Mysuru half-day trip.

description.zh: 凯奥拉德奥国家公园（旧称巴拉特普尔鸟类保护区）是世界上最重要的候鸟栖息地之一，每年冬季吸引数以万计的候鸟从中亚、西伯利亚和喜马拉雅山越冬，共记录超过370种鸟类。1985年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Keoladeo National Park (formerly Bharatpur Bird Sanctuary) is one of the world's most important bird wintering grounds. Tens of thousands of migratory birds from Central Asia, Siberia and the Himalayas overwinter here annually, with over 370 species recorded. UNESCO-listed in 1985.

zh: 世界遗产
候鸟保护区
观鸟

location.zh: 拉贾斯坦邦巴拉特普尔市

zh: 370余种鸟类，包括稀有的西伯利亚鹤（部分年份可见）
冬季（10—3月）候鸟云集，骑自行车或乘三轮车观鸟
公园内的自行车游览：在水鸟聚集的沼泽地间骑行穿行
en: 370+ bird species including the rare Siberian Crane (sighted in some years)
Winter (October–March) sees enormous concentrations of migratory waterfowl
Cycling through the park between heron colonies and marshes is the classic experience

admission.zh: 外国游客500卢比

tips.zh: 距阿格拉约55公里，是「黄金三角」行程的绝佳补充。入园后可租自行车或雇请本地持证鸟类向导，极大提升观鸟体验。
tips.en: About 55 km from Agra — a natural add-on to the Golden Triangle circuit. Hire a local licensed bird guide inside the park; they dramatically enhance the experience.

description.zh: 帕塔达卡尔是7—8世纪遮娄其王朝的王家加冕圣地，保存有10座大型神庙，独特地集中呈现了印度南部德拉威式和北部那加拉式两种建筑风格于同一地点，是印度建筑史上的罕见标本。1987年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Pattadakal was the royal coronation site of the Chalukya dynasty in the 7th–8th centuries. Its ten major temples display a rare coexistence of both Dravidian (South Indian) and Nagara (North Indian) architectural styles at a single site — a unique laboratory of Indian temple architecture. UNESCO-listed in 1987.

zh: 世界遗产
遮娄其建筑
卡纳塔克

location.zh: 卡纳塔克邦北部巴加尔科特区

zh: 维鲁帕夏神庙：最大的神庙，以精美的浮雕壁画和沙德那教神话故事著称
同一地点南印度德拉威式与北印度那加拉式两种建筑风格并列
通常与附近的艾霍尔（Aihole）遗址组成「遮娄其三角」联游
en: Virupaksha Temple: the largest, celebrated for its exquisite narrative friezes from the Ramayana and Mahabharata
Rare coexistence of Dravidian and Nagara temple styles on a single site
Typically combined with nearby Aihole to form a 'Chalukya Triangle' itinerary

admission.zh: 外国游客600卢比

tips.zh: 通常与巴达米（Badami）和艾霍尔安排在同一天，三地组成「遮娄其三角」，从班加罗尔约7—8小时车程。
tips.en: Usually visited with Badami and Aihole in a single day on the 'Chalukya Triangle' — about 7–8 hours from Bengaluru by road.
